reason: The test passed an externally-derived Qwen image as Alucard reference input. Upstream documents the reference input as a previous animation frame generated/paired in the same sprite domain, not an arbitrary design image. Therefore the noisy result cannot be used as a fair model-quality verdict.

observed_output.visual: recognizable ghostlike silhouette contaminated by full-canvas multicolor speckle/noise; not production-readable

conditioning_issue: The generated 128x128 conditioning reference also lost the mouth during reduction. This is a real harness defect but is not sufficient to explain the catastrophic noisy output.
next_control: Use Alucard in its upstream-supported text-to-sprite mode with no reference input, fixed seed and default documented sampling.
